text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The talk is electric surrounding the runners participating in today's race. King Halo, famous recently for riling up the media, is no exception.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Moving to the waiting room of Yasuda Kinen, King Halo proclaims it doesn't matter who she has to face in today's race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She will break past any obstacle standing in her way and kick away the competition. Her enthusiasm is palpable in light of today's challenge.
